understood_as: Run only the approved frozen natural-path and matched-history diagnostics on all40 final architecture policies. Preserve inputs and failed seeds, perform zero optimizer/statistics updates, then close this architecture branch without new training or a larger panel.
selection: mode only; full action probabilities are diagnostic queries, not sample rollouts
A: Natural validation reset, waits outside history, original fixed/mutant kernels. 40x16x4x2=5120 episodes. Compare every path and summary to the already saved final evaluation; any mismatch stops the probe.
B: In fixed, apply the declared delay then the transformed RIGHT action (first action of the existing reference route), recording that controlled pre-action observation/action. Clone this wall-front state and its history. Apply transformed DASH_RIGHT versus NOOP once. Require exact equality of EVERY state leaf and the raw current observation/goal. Record mismatches and exclude, never repair. Continue both branches in fixed until delivery or the original tick64. 40x64x2=5120 maximum continuations. Prefix is policy-independent, fixed before querying any policy.
history_contract: Reuse spatial_architecture.py unchanged: seven completed observation/action pairs plus current observation. Forced waits leave history empty. GRU re-encodes this window from zero, not an episode-wide hidden state. Do not add collision flags or modify masking.
negative_control: For every current_mlp seed/q, exact identical current input must yield exactly identical immediate probabilities and complete deterministic continuation in B; otherwise write failed.json and withhold mechanism claims.
metrics: A reports first dash and bug-relevant wall block, same-position same-direction retries, first subsequent physical displacement latency, subsequent route and success. Conditional recovery requires at least one block and eventual delivery. B reports TV, blocked-direction probability, both forced-action probabilities at the common prefix, retries at the panel wall, full continuation and success. Absolute discounted return is gamma^(delivery_tick-1); remaining return is gamma^(continuation_steps-1). Failed returns are0. Episode length includes wait/prefix/branch; control length subtracts only forced wait. Failed length is not successful path efficiency.
accounting: At most10240 retained episodes and655360 active episode/continuation ticks; B common prefix, branch construction, and forced waits reported separately. JAX padded scan slots are not active transitions. No extra sample rollout, optimizer or normalization update. Interrupted uncommitted evaluation attempts are separately journaled.
analysis: Aggregate layout/delay cells within learner seed first. Show all5 seed values for each architecture/q and delay, plus A conditional denominators and all B exclusions. No episode-based inferential sample sizes. No bootstrap required for this descriptive frozen probe.
limits: These16 layouts are transformations of one fixture, not new spatial structures. Delays10/12 are known follow-up conditions. B is a forced-action history intervention whose support probabilities must be shown, not assumed on-policy. Distinguishing dash from WAIT does not isolate action identity from failure meaning. A and B remain separate; no belief-state or bug-understanding claim.
completion: Verify all40 source checkpoint/config/metadata/evaluation hashes, unchanged frozen parameters, A parity, B exact states, current-MLP negative controls, and expected counts before publishing verified_complete.json. Reuse only complete per-policy integrity receipts; resume partial policies without deleting their prior attempts. Stop numerical/integrity failures rather than retrying them indefinitely.
